meaning: OPTIONAL rewrite table: every current constant name of this repository with its exact expression in traditional generators (classical polylogarithms, zeta values, Clausen values, log-sine integrals, multiple polylogarithms at sixth roots of unity). Data only and additive: no symbol, no coefficient file and no Vakint code uses it; a later release may rewrite the 3L/4L files with these expressions (the old names kept as aliases).
conventions: w = exp(i pi/3); Li_{a..}(x..) = sum_{k1>..>kr>=1} prod x_i^{k_i}/k_i^{a_i}; Ls_j^(k)(t) = -int_0^t phi^k ln^{j-1-k}|2 sin(phi/2)| dphi; s6 = vakint::s6 (= Li_{5,1}(-1,-1) + zeta(6)); see GENERATORS.md and DICTIONARY.md
non_reducing_constants: LIFTED-DEFINITIONS.md: Bessel moments (Broadhurst c_{5,k} and eps-jets), every PR*D2Eps*/PR14ep* as an explicit four-loop Euclidean integral, D5bar3
